claims.assertion: Swaruu (9) says Suzy-class craft can enter hyperspace while stationary and remain undetectable and invulnerable there, enabling surveillance, extraction, passage through walls, or attacks.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She says immersion toroids reduce mass-drag during plasma acceleration, allowing speeds near one-third light speed; interstellar travel uses hyperspace jumps.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She describes mapping space through frequency readings at sampled points and inferring adjacent unmapped regions mathematically; Dhor says time layers and changing frequencies add complexity.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9); Dhor Káal’el (qualification)
